talking_points: Gong Activate promises 'AI wins deals for you' — ask which of their current workflows they would first trust an autonomous agent to run end-to-end, and how Gong measures whether the 'self-improving revenue loop' is actually closing deals.

With ARR past $500M and 55%+ YoY growth driven by enterprises consolidating Engage/Forecast/Enable onto one platform, ask how the consolidation story lands with buyers who are already paying Clari or Salesloft — and what a $1M+ customer rollout looks like.

Pricing is the churn flashpoint competitors exploit ($250/seat plus $5K-$50K platform fees) — ask how Gong is defending renewals and packaging new capabilities like Gong Enrich and Agent Builder for customers pushing back on platform fees against $19-$120/seat challengers.
